spans.s:
शय mfn. (-यः-या or यी-यं) Asleep, sleeping.
 m. (-यः)
 1. A hand.
 2. A
snake, (Boa constrictor.)
 3. Sleep, sleeping.
 4. A bed, a couch.
 5.
Abuse, imprecation.
 E. शी to sleep, aff. घ, टच् or अच् ।

शय्या f. (-य्या)
 1. A bed, a couch, a sopha.
 2. Tying in knots, stringing.
E. शी to sleep, क्यप् aff., and अयङ् substituted for the vowel.

साय m. (-यः)
 1. Evening, close of day.
 2. An arrow.
 3. End, termination.
close in general.
 E. षो to end or destroy, &c., घञ् aff.

शयण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) Asleep, sleeping,
 E. शी to sleep, अण्डच् Unādi aff.

शयथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Asleep, sleeping.
 m. (-थः)
 1. Death, dying.
 2. A
[]
sort of snake, the

Boa.
 3

. A boar.
 4. A fish.
 E. शी to sleep, अथच्
Unādi aff.

शयन n. (-नं)
 1.

Sleep.
 2

. A bed, a couch.
 3. Copulation.
 E. शी to sleep, ल्युट् aff.

शयान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sleeping, asleep.
 E. शी to sleep, शानच् aff.

सायन n. (-नं) The longitude of a planet reckoned from the vernal
equinoctial point.
 E. स with, अयन the equinoctial period.

शयनगृह n. (-हं) A bed-chamber.
 E. शयन and गृह house.

शयनागार m. (-रः) A bed chamber.
 E. शयन and आगार house.

शयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit for or suitable to sleep, to be slept on, &c.
n. (-यं) A bed, a couch.
 E. शी to sleep, अनीयर् aff. of the future
participle; also with कन् added शयनीयक n. (-कं) ।

शयनैकादशी f. (-शी) The eleventh day of the light-half of Āshādha, on
which VIṢṆU'S sleep commences.
 E. शयन, एकादशी 11th lunation.

शयानक m. (-कः)
 1. A snake.
 2. A lizard.
 E. शी to sleep, आनक् Unādi aff.

शयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Sleepy, slothful, sluggish.
 m. (-लुः)
 1. A kind of
snake, the

Boa.
 2

. A dog.
 3. A jackal.
 E. शी to sleep, आलुच् aff,
implying disposition or habit.

शयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asleep.
 n. (-तं) A plant, (Cordia myxa.)
 n. (-तं)
Sleep, sleeping.
 E. शी to sleep, aff. क्त ।

शयितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sleeping, asleep.
 E. शीङ् to sleep, क्तवतु aff.

शयित्वा Ind. Having slept.
 E. शी to sleep, क्त्वा aff.

शयु m. (-युः) A large snake, (Boa.)
 E. शी to sleep, उ Unādi aff.

शयुन m. (-नः) A large kind of snake, (Boa.)
 E. शीङ् to sleep, Unādi aff. उनन् ।

शायक m. (-कः)
 1. An arrow.
 2. A sword.
 E. शी to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.; also सायक ।

सायक m. (-कः)
 1. An arrow.
 2. A sword.
 f. (-यिका) Standing in order.
E. षो to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.

शायिका f. (-का) Sleeping.
 E. शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.

शायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lying down.
 E. शी to sleep, णिनि aff.

सायिन् m. (-यी) A horseman, a groom.
 E. स for सह with, अय् to go, णिनि aff.
सय् r. 1st cl. (सयते) To go, to move.

सयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Endeavouring, taking pains.
 n. Adv. (-त्नं) Vigor-
ously, assiduously.
 E. स with, यत्न effort.
सयूथ्य m. (-थ्यः) One of the same tribe.

INDRA.
 2

. Proximity to a wife.
 3. A pair of nip-
pers for cutting betel-nut.
 4. Uterine brother. Adj. Having the
same womb.
 E. स for सह with, or सम् like, योनि pudendum muliebre.

सायंकाल m. (-लः) Eventide, evening.
 E. सायम् evening, and काल time.
सायकपुङ्ख mf. (-ङ्खः-ङ्खा) The feathered end of an arrow.

सायन्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging to the evening, vespertine.
 E. साय
evening, ट्युल् aff., तुट् augment.

सायम् Ind. Evening, close of the day, in the evening.
 E. सो-ञमु aff.

सायमण्डन n. (-नं) The place or time of sunset.
 E. साय, मण्डन embellishing.

सायाह्न m. (-ह्नः) The evening, eventide.
 E. सायम् evening, and अहन् day.

सायुज्य n. (-ज्यं)
 1. Likeness, similarity.
 2. Identification, intimate
union, (especially with the Deity, considered as one of the four
grades of mukti.)
 E. स with, युज् what joins, ष्यञ् aff.

साये Ind. In the evening, at the close of the day.
 E. साय evening, the
seventh case, used as a particle.
